surviving_results.result: Uniform reduction of quantum minimax to diagonal classical entropy game, including coherent inputs/adversaries and infinite-dimensional finite-energy states.
Explicit constant-loss curve for every fixed positive energy ratio, atomic/diffuse profiles, global entropy certificates, and feasible discrete approximation.
Monotonicity, concavity, ratio-sequence extension, plateau, and vanishing deficit exactly for M=o(E).
Strict positive asymptotic separation of the thermal adversary for each fixed 0<c<1.
Square-root small-c law and quadratic approach to the plateau.

adversarial_checks: Largest eigenvalue bound from Gibbs relative entropy
Normalization and conversion between logarithm bases
Full-support relative entropy and global inequalities
Both discrete energy constraints and order of limits
Thermal comparison with mixed reference measure
Known initial solver failure kept distinct

known_components: Binary-branch constant h2(lambda), already visible in the depolarizing formula
Vacuum reset input optimization and related branch mechanism
Identity/replacement channel family explicitly present in finite-dimensional literature since at least 2005
prior_art_comparison.probable_specialized_advance: Uniform reduction plus explicit full fixed-ratio minimax constant curve, atomic/diffuse optimal constructions and global discrete certificates; thermal adversary gap and endpoint laws.
distinctions: Additive-noise Gaussian saddle is a different game
Bosonic beam-splitter attenuator with engineered environment is a different channel and objective
Thermal input suboptimality for a fixed vacuum reset differs from thermal adversary suboptimality under a reset budget
prior_art_comparison.unresolved_access_limit: Baitenov 2024 full text unavailable; abstract alone does not settle detailed overlap.

initial_failed_case.interpretation: Failure of active moment equations/saddle certificate, not automatically violation of the upper reset budget.

independent_checks.interpretation: Floating-point corroboration, not proof, interval certification, or uniform lower bound.

recommendation.scope: Scientific recommendation on this exact candidate; private review, not editorial acceptance.

quality_score_justification: Between very good and excellent: convincing specialized analytical work with genuine coherence, infinite-dimensional, atomic and feasibility difficulties addressed by global certificates; methods substantially adapt established entropy tools.
importance_airr_justification: Strong specialized advance with probable new exact structure in a narrow adversarial reset problem; no demonstrated field-wide reorganization, central-problem resolution, broad coding consequence, or Millennium relevance. Separately judged, not a mean of criteria.

anchors.10: Recognized unconditional Millennium solution with extraordinary independent verification; cannot be credited solely by a model review.
